book.name: Job
book.title: Job Wotfo Gudbala Pipul Abum Trabul?

content: Elifas bin reken Job bin meigim im ronwan trabul
Wal Elifas bin kipgon tok, “Job, yu jingat langa sambodi hu gin album yu. Maitbi sambala einjul garra kaman.
Job, yu nomo sabi enijing. Maitbi if yu jidan wailwan o jelaswan, tharran na garra kilim yu ded.

Aibin luk sambala pipul hu nomo bin sabi enijing. Deibin gedim ola ebrijing blanga lilwail, bat God bin jandim nogudwan ting en binijimap olabat, jis laik det tri wen sambodi pulumat im garram im rut.
En wen im hepin lagijat, olabat biginini nomo garram enibodi blanga album olabat langa det kothaus.
Afta tharran, gridibala en hanggribala pipul kaman en binijimap ola sid daga blanga olabat, en stilimbat ola ebrijing.
Bat ola nogud trabul nomo jis kamat brom graun.
Wen pipul bon, trabul garra kaman langa olabat. Im jis laik det spak weya kamat brom det bush faiya en gowap langa skai.
Job, if ai bina yu, ai bina askim God blanga album mi.
Im gin dum detmatj brabli klebabala ting.
God oldei jandim rein blanga wodarimbat ola fam.
Im oldei maindimbat detlot hu jidan lobala, en im album detlot hu oldei jidan soribala.
God oldei stapam detlot plen blanga detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudbala ting.
Olabat jis laik detlot blainwan pipul hu kaan luk gudwei langa deitaim.
God oldei lukaftumbat ola po pipul brom ol detlot hu oldei faitfait en ardimbat olabat.
Detlot powan pipul oldei kipgon trastimbat langa God en olabat oldei abumbat feyago.”
God oldei lukaftumbat pipul nomeda olabat abum trabul

Wal Elifas bin kipgon tok, “Job yu garra jidan gudbinjiwei. Nomeda God det brabli haibalawan bin panishim yu, bat stil yu garra jidan hepiwan. Im mait meigim yu abumbat pein en ardimbat detmatj, bat im garra bendijimap en meigim yu sowa gudwan.
God garra maindimbat yu brom deinja nomeda haumatj trabul garra kaman.
Langa det taim wen im wo taim en wen olabat nomo garram eni daga, God garra kipgon maindimbat yu.
Yu garra jidan seifwan en yu kaan bradin, nomeda olabat tok nogudbala wed en trai blanga ardimbat yu.
Yu garra laflafbat wen yu irrimbat ola nogudbala ting garra hepin, en wen dei tok yu nomo garram eni daga. En yu kaan bradin blanga eni wailwan enimul.
Olabat garra jidan kwaitwan en ol detlot stoniwan pedik garra jidan gudwan.
Blanga yu haus garra jidan seifwan, en blanga yu shipmob garra jidan seifwan du.
Yu garra abum bigismob biginini, mowa den detlot gras langa dijan graun.
Yu garra jidan laibala longtaim en blanga yu bodi garra jidan strongbala raidap yu garra dai.
Melabat bin jinggabat dijan longtaim en melabat sabi ebrijing garra kaman trubala. Wal yu irrim en len mowa, wulijim yu garra sabi brabliwei.” Lagijat na Elifas bin tok.
